command:
cd /testbed && git status --short && sed -n '1,115p' autograd/core.py && sed -n '1,100p' tests/test_scipy.py && sed -n '1,180p' autograd/test_util.py && cat pyproject.toml && python --version && cat > /tmp/sylvester_vjp_repro.py <<'EOF'
import autograd.numpy as np
from autograd import grad
from autograd.scipy.linalg import solve_sylvester

A = np.array([[1., 2.], [3., 4.]])
B = np.array([[5., 6.], [7., 8.]])
Q = np.array([[9., 10.], [11., 12.]])


def test_func(a):
    return np.sum(solve_sylvester(a, B, Q))


print(grad(test_func)(A))
EOF
PYTHONPATH=/testbed python /tmp/sylvester_vjp_repro.py
